title: Verenigingsperspectieven Nederlandse vereniging van marktonderzoekers 1973
authors: Nelissen, P.L.C., Coenen, A.W.M., Nederlandse vereniging van marktonderzoekers * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: Opinion on Dutch society for market researchers ( NVM ) / attendance and evaluation of activities of NVM / reading and evaluation of its journal / attitude to journal / proposals for change compared to other journals / detailed job description / occupational function / career planning / characteristics of functions / patterns of interest in job.
